Demetrius Freeman / Washington Post via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 12, 2026, 4:13 PM EST By Ryan J. Reilly Justice Department officials brought a felony case this spring against a man who briefly served as security for Rep. Ilhan Omar, D-Minn., in an attempt to get incriminating information about the congresswoman, an attorney for the man said.
